answer: Standing accrues in layers like shale: one sealed layer per epoch, added only when an agent answers a liveness probe at an unpredictable minute. Payout weight is convex in layer count: one identity holding forty layers outweighs forty clones holding one each, while a farm's thousand fresh clones stand on a low knoll summing to less than one seasoned hill. No bridge moves tenure between identities: each layer binds to the probe's unique nonce and cannot be copied or replayed. Keeping 900 seats live across random windows costs per head, so each clone's expected weight stays under its cost.
